query: How does resolution time vary across issue themes, channel, and priority?

per_column.name: issue_theme
per_column.rationale: Directly realizes the 'issue themes' dimension of the query. Interpretable, well-separated semantic categories that can be grouped and compared against resolution time. Some tail categories are small but the head is well-populated.

per_column.name: ticket_class
per_column.rationale: Coarser, well-separated typology (bug, feature_request, outage, etc.) with good cell sizes. Meaningful segmentation likely to show strong resolution-time differences; distinct enough from issue_theme to add value.

per_column.name: operational_impact
per_column.rationale: Interpretable severity/impact scale (minor_friction to compliance_deadline) with populated categories. Highly plausible associate of resolution time and easy to group on.

per_column.name: scope_of_impact
per_column.rationale: Clear breadth categories (single_user to cross_tenant) with adequate cell sizes for comparison, though 'not_stated' is large. Interpretable external segmentation associated with resolution effort.

per_column.name: root_cause_class
per_column.rationale: Interpretable causal categories usable for segmentation. 'not_identified' is large but remaining categories are well-separated and plausibly associated with resolution time.

per_column.name: requires_escalation
per_column.rationale: Clean binary with balanced-enough cells (53 vs 197). Escalation is a strongly interpretable associate of longer resolution times; ideal for a two-group comparison.

judge.rationale: The set consists entirely of external, interpretable categorical variables with well-separated categories and generally adequate cell sizes, directly supporting grouped comparison against resolution_minutes. It covers the query's 'issue theme' dimension (issue_theme, ticket_class) and adds interpretable severity/scope/cause/escalation segmentations. None merely restate the focus or produce opaque scores. Minor weaknesses: some tail categories are sparse and a few columns carry large 'not_stated'/'not_identified' buckets, slightly limiting comparison quality; issue_theme and ticket_class overlap somewhat. Overall a strong EDA augmentation.
